$comment: Maryland's two county minimum wages both step on July 1 -- the opposite cycle from the state rate, which has been flat at $15.00 since 2024. Prince George's County's ordinance was overtaken by the state rate and is not carried.

sources.title: Montgomery County, MD Office of Human Rights -- Minimum Wage Increase (July 1, 2026)
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session across the county's own press release and Office of Human Rights page: $18.00 large / $16.50 mid-size / $15.95 small, effective 2026-07-01 under the county's annual regional-inflation adjustment.

jurisdictions.name: Howard County
jurisdictions.coverage: All employers. Howard County's small-employer tier (fewer than 15 employees) rose from $15.50 to $16.00 on 2026-07-01, UNIFYING the county on a single rate for the first time -- a table still carrying two Howard County rates is out of date.

sources.title: Howard County, MD -- Minimum Wage schedule (Finance Department)
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session at the county's own Finance Department page. Its own wage schedule table shows the small-employer tier reaching $16.00 on 2026-07-01, unifying with the county's single rate, and confirms that from 2027-01-01 onward increases are set by CPI-U rather than by council action.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Labor Center -- Inventory of US City and County Minimum Wage Ordinances
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session. The standing national census of local minimum wage ordinances -- used here to establish WHICH jurisdictions exist (so none is silently omitted), with each rate then cross-checked against a second source.

knownGaps: Maryland tipped cash wages are set at the STATE level ($3.63); neither county publishes a separate tipped figure, so none is asserted here.
